command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.rs|*.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.py|*.go|*.java|*.rb|*.php|*.c|*.h|*.cc|*.cpp|*.hpp|*.cs|*.swift|*.kt|*.scala) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; [ "$(wc -c < "$f")" -gt 8000 ] || exit 0; jq -nc --arg p "$OMH_GRAPH_PROJECT" --arg f "$f" '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":($f + " is large. For one symbol rather than the whole file: get_code_snippet --project " + $p + " --qualified-name <name>, and search_graph finds the name.")}}'
